description.en-US: Idle Fantasy is a free and open source offline idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train skills, fight in dungeons, craft gear, and complete quests. No internet connection, account, or ads required. Features • 23 trainable skills: Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting, Farming, Thieving, Smithing, Cooking, Fletching, Crafting, Firemaking, Runecrafting, Herblore, Construction, Prayer, Mercantile, Agility, Slayer, Attack, Strength, Defense, Ranged, Magic, and Hitpoints • Session-based training: Start a session and close the app. Come back up to an hour later to collect your loot and XP. Agility reduces session time. • 33 dungeons: Fight solo bosses and enemies to earn combat XP, coins, and rare drops. Equip weapons and armour to deal more damage. • Crafting system: Smelt bars, cook fish, fletch bows and arrows, craft jewellery. Consume gathered materials and earn XP and items. • Prayer: Bury bones collected from combat to earn Prayer XP. • Equipment system: Equip weapons, armour, tools, and jewellery to boost stats and skill efficiency. • Quest system: 189 quests spanning all skills. Earn XP rewards on completion. • Pet system: Rare pets can drop while training skills. Each pet provides a permanent XP boost to their linked skill. • Achievements: Track milestones across levelling, combat, quests, and collections. • NPC Shop: Buy supplies and sell your gathered resources for coins. • No ads. No accounts. No internet required. Your save data stays on your device. • Translations: Partial and full translations available for 20 languages. Idle Fantasy is free software released under the GPL-3.0 licence. Source code is available on the project repository. Get updates faster Add the official Idle Fantasy repository to F-Droid to receive updates as soon as they are released, instead of waiting for the main F-Droid index to catch up. 1. Open F-Droid and go to Settings → Repositories 2. Tap + and paste: https://idlefantasy.tristinbaker.xyz/fdroid/repo 3. Search for Idle Fantasy, open the app page, and under Repositories set Idle Fantasy as the preferred source.

whatsNew.en-US:
• Elder Isle sessions always credit XP to the elder pool, even if the isle flag desyncs mid-session.
• Time zone changes no longer reset daily/weekly quests, guild dailies, or the bounty board.
• Slayer Master view auto-refreshes when a background session completes.
• Opening Ancient Treasures in bulk is much faster on large stacks.
• Equip picker sorts by stat power instead of pickup order.
• Elder Isle crafting no longer uses mainland tools, boosts, or pets, and pays XP to the elder pool.

• Isle dungeon clears now correctly count toward story quest counters. Fought Beach & Cliffs but the "First Steps" quest stayed 0/8? Fixed — every successful isle dungeon run now increments the counter the way mainland dungeons already did.
• Sea Serpent is now available on the Combat tab the moment the Dock is built, instead of also requiring Grand Monument tier 5 and total level 1500. The Dock (Construction 90) is a heavy enough gate on its own.
• Isle skill sessions queued on the island no lo

• Workers can no longer be assigned Elder Isle activities. Elder ores, trees, fish, agility courses, bars, and cooked food are now hidden from the worker skill sheets, closing an exploit where a mainland worker could mine Starforged Ore (and other isle-tier resources) for isle XP into the mainland pool.

• Elder Isle: sail from your Dock at Construction 90, defeat the Sea Serpent, and unlock a second region with its own separate skill tracks, dungeons, and story arc
• Elder skills level on their own XP pool that starts fresh at 1 and stays untouched by mainland prestige, boosts, gear, and pets
• 12-quest main story chain across 4 acts, auto-completing as you meet each objective; 13 lore fragments unlock in the Lore Master as you progress
• 8-piece Elder set is the isle's BIS armor, crafted from

• The Runecrafting sheet now shows the total runes a session will produce and correctly factors the level and ash catalyst multipliers into the projected XP, so a redwood-ashes run no longer under-reports either
• Rotating a piece of furniture in the house editor no longer treats it as a new purchase; rotation variants share ownership and storage with the base piece
• The Herblore potion sheet now lists every ash tier the player owns, dimming ones that don't cover the current quantity with an "o
